ci_support_linux_64_python3.11.____cpyth:
DOCKER_PLATFORM:
- linux/amd64
c_compiler:
- gcc
c_compiler_version:
- '15'
c_stdlib:
- sysroot
c_stdlib_version:
- '2.17'
channel_sources:
- conda-forge
channel_targets:
- conda-forge main
docker_image:
- quay.io/condaforge/linux-anvil-x86_64:alma10
pin_run_as_build:
  python:
    min_pin: x.x
    max_pin: x.x
python:
- 3.11.* *_cpython
target_platform:
- linux-64
name: pyjelly
raw_meta_yaml:
# yaml-language-server: $schema=https://raw.githubusercontent.com/prefix-dev/recipe-format/main/schema.json
schema_version: 1

context:
  version: "0.9.0"
  mypy_min: "2.4"
  protobuf_min: "6.30.0"
  # TODO: remove if/when oldest supported is available
  protobuf_check_min: "6.31.1"
  # tests use `Dataset.default_graph`
  rdflib_check_min: "7.3"

package:
  name: pyjelly
  version: ${{ version }}

source:
  - url: https://pypi.org/packages/source/p/pyjelly/pyjelly-${{ version }}.tar.gz
    sha256: bbc935bccfad94f10557870dcb788ff28670f4f8b3d464efa2a54cc6b7493993
    target_directory: dist

  - url: https://github.com/Jelly-RDF/jelly-protobuf/archive/7c3773f6e3704440b445b30faa677516a45d3b60.tar.gz
    sha256: 90231ae0d5c15ed53272b6b696d1587e04784227786f6126654e99599bfe6e35
    target_directory: dist/submodules/protobuf  # (v1.2.0)

  - url: https://github.com/Jelly-RDF/pyjelly/archive/refs/tags/v${{ version }}.tar.gz
    sha256: 82052117d54c34557dd323fad3dbc08995cd1c08b2d14106ad6601600869339d
    target_directory: src

build:
  number: 0
  script:
    - ${{ PYTHON }} ${{ "$RECIPE_DIR" if unix else "%RECIPE_DIR%" }}/deref_symlinks.py
    - cd dist
    - ${{ PYTHON }} -m pip install . -vv --no-deps --no-build-isolation --disable-pip-version-check --check-build-dependencies

requirements:
  build:
    - ${{ compiler("c") }}
    - ${{ stdlib("c") }}
    - if: build_platform != target_platform
      then:
        - cross-python_${{ target_platform }}
        - mypy >=${{ mypy_min }}
        - python
  host:
    - hatch-mypyc
    - hatchling >=1.24
    - mypy >=${{ mypy_min }}
    - pip
    - python
  run:
    - mypy_extensions >=1.0.0
    - protobuf >=${{ protobuf_min }}
    - python
    - typing_extensions >=4.12.2
  run_constraints:
    - rdflib >=7.1.4

tests:
  - package_contents:
      # strict: true
      #     error Package content test failed:
      #     error - No match for files glob: lib/python-3.15/site-packages/*__mypyc.*.so
      #     error
      #     error Strict mode violations:
      #     error - lib/python3.15/site-packages/cb523b6bada1c6eba8b4__mypyc.cpython-315-x86_64-linux-gnu.so
      site_packages:
        - pyjelly-${{ version }}.dist-info/**
  - python:
      imports: pyjelly
      pip_check: true
  - files:
      source:
        - src/tests/
        - src/pyproject.toml
    requirements:
      run:
        - coverage
        - hypothesis
        - inline-snapshot
        - pip
        - protobuf ${{ protobuf_check_min ~ "." if match(python, "<3.15") }}*
        - pytest >=8.3.4,<9.2.0
        - pytest-mock
        - pytest-subtests
        - rdflib ${{ rdflib_check_min }}.*
    script:
      - pip check
      - cd src
      - coverage run --source=pyjelly --branch -m pytest -vv --tb=long --color=yes
      - coverage report --show-missing --skip-covered --fail-under=16

about:
  homepage: https://pypi.org/project/pyjelly
  summary: Jelly-RDF implementation for Python
  license: Apache-2.0
  license_file:
    - dist/LICENSE
    - dist/submodules/protobuf/LICENSE
  documentation: https://jelly-rdf.github.io/pyjelly
  repository: https://github.com/Jelly-RDF/pyjelly

extra:
  recipe-maintainers:
    - bollwyvl
